name: meeting-follow-up-assistant
description: Turn meeting transcripts and notes into evidence-grounded summaries, decisions, action items, owners, deadlines, open questions, and polished follow-ups.

interface.longDescription: Analyze supplied meeting transcripts, notes, agendas, and discussion records. Separate confirmed decisions from proposals, extract supported action items and owners, preserve deadline wording, identify open questions and blockers, and draft internal or client-ready follow-ups. Every important item stays grounded in the supplied source; ambiguous ownership, dates, and decisions are labeled rather than guessed.
defaultPrompt: Summarize this meeting and extract supported decisions and action items.
Create a follow-up email from these notes without adding unsupported commitments.
List open questions, blockers, owners, and deadlines from this transcript.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not offer purchases, payments, subscriptions, or paid referrals.

publication.release_notes: Corrected the ZIP layout so plugin.json, skills, and assets are at the package root. No behavior changes.
